প্রজ্ঞাপন

তারিখ : ১৬ আষাঢ়, ১৪২৭ বঙ্গাব্দ/৩০ জুন, ২০২০ খ্রিষ্টাব্দ

এস.আর.ও. নং ১৮২-আইন/২০২০/৯১/কাস্টমস।-Customs Act, 1969 (Act No. IV of 1969) এর section 19 এর sub-section (1) এবং মূল্য সংযোজন কর ও সম্পূরক শুল্ক আইন, ২০১২ (২০১২ সনের ৪৭ নং আইন) এর ধারা ১২৬ এর উপ-ধারা (১) এ প্রদত্ত ক্ষমতাবলে সরকার, জাতীয় রাজস্ব বোর্ডের সহিত পরামর্শক্রমে, জনস্বার্থে, ৩ জুন, ২০২০ খ্রিষ্টাব্দ তারিখে জারীকৃত প্রজ্ঞাপন এস.আর.ও. নং- ১২১-আইন/২০২০/৭২/কাস্টমস এর নিম্নরূপ সংশোধন করিল, যথা:-

Customs Act 1969: Section 19(1) of this Act empowers the Government, in consultation with the National Board of Revenue, to grant exemptions or issue notifications in the public interest.
Value Added Tax and Supplementary Duty A: Section 126(1) of this Act provides the legal authority for the Government to issue specific notifications and amendments in consultation with the National Board of Revenue.
National Board of Revenue: The Board serves as the primary advisory body to the Government in the exercise of its powers to grant exemptions and issue regulatory notifications under customs and value added tax laws.
S.R.O. 121-AIN/2020: This specific earlier notification is being amended through the authority granted by the Customs Act and the Value Added Tax and Supplementary Duty Act.

Industrial Consumer: The term Industrial Consumer is deleted from the specified clause of the notification.
VAT Divisional Officer: The administrative authority previously held by the Deputy Commissioner or Assistant Commissioner is now transferred to the VAT Divisional Officer regarding specific clause requirements.
The VAT Divisional Officer is authorized to sign and stamp the certification document for industrial importers.
Industrial IRC Holder: Provisions within the notification are explicitly restricted to apply only to Industrial IRC holder entities that are also VAT compliant.
VAT Compliant: Entities must maintain VAT compliant status to qualify for specific exemptions or industrial provisions.
Industrial enterprises that are VAT compliant must verify their status through the submission of regular VAT returns as per the newly inserted conditions.
Industrial Machinery and Spare Parts: Specific exemptions or provisions related to the import of machinery and spare parts do not apply to government, autonomous, diplomatic, or other exempt organizations that are not required to hold an Industrial IRC or file VAT returns.
Industrial Import Registration Certifica: The certification process for industrial importers now requires confirmation of a valid and renewed Industrial Import Registration Certificate issued by the Chief Controller of Imports and Exports.
Value Added Tax: Importers must maintain a registry of machinery and spare parts imported at concessional rates and must have filed all required Value Added Tax returns with the relevant authorities.

processed_clauses.resolved_text: ২। এই প্রজ্ঞাপন ১১ জুন, ২০২০ খ্রিষ্টাব্দ তারিখে কার্যকর হইয়াছে বলিয়া গণ্য হইবে।

Statutory Regulatory Order: This notification is deemed to have come into effect on a specific date in June, 2020.
